title: Design System: The FastTrack Madrasah — Student Portal

glyph.purpose: The hero Amiri Arabic letterform, inked to progress. Hero only.

display.purpose: Student name on the hub; page titles.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono captions and section headers.

readout.purpose: Measured values only — IDs, weeks, counts, percentages.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The only elevation: a lit sheet on the dark board. Every sheet carries it; nothing else does.

shadows.name: chalk-glow
shadows.purpose: Reserved for mastery — the glowing glyph ink and completed stroke marks only.

motion.name: ink-fill
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for the mastery glyph inking in (clip-path, 900ms). Snaps under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one assertive surface — Continue, Join class, Verify.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Continue learning <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#24e08a; color:#04160f; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.01em; padding:10px 20px; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#16c476; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #24e08a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A stamped field on the sheet — settings, cancel, add.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:transparent; color:#f4f7f6; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #34423f; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#161a1c; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #24e08a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.description: The primary container: a lit sheet on the board, ruled edge, soft cast shadow.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-sheet { background:#0e1112; border:1px solid #26302f; border-radius:4px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset, 0 14px 30px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-spec-label { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:0.6875rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.16em; color:#7e8a89; } .ds-sheet-title { margin:6px 0 0; font-weight:600; font-size:1.125rem; color:#f4f7f6; }

components.name: Nav Tab
components.description: Numbered specimen section index; active carries a green underline stroke and aria-current.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab is-active" aria-current="page">Home</button><button class="ds-tab">Classes</button><button class="ds-tab">Lessons</button></nav>

components.name: Mastery Glyph
components.description: The signature: an Amiri letterform written in glowing green chalk from a faint ghost to full mastery via a --fill clip.
components.css: .ds-glyph { position:relative; display:inline-block; font-family:'Amiri',serif; font-size:10rem; line-height:0.9; } .ds-glyph-ghost { color:rgba(240,244,239,0.10); } .ds-glyph-ink { position:absolute; inset:0; color:#24e08a; text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(22,184,119,0.45); clip-path:inset(calc((1 - var(--fill,1)) * 100%) 0 0 0); transition:clip-path 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-glyph-ink { transition:none; } }

components.name: Strokes Meter
components.description: Mastery as a row of drilled chalk strokes; completed strokes glow brand-green.
components.css: .ds-strokes { display:flex; gap:3px; align-items:flex-end; height:20px; } .ds-strokes span { width:4px; height:14px; border-radius:2px; background:#34423f; } .ds-strokes span:nth-child(2){height:18px} .ds-strokes span:nth-child(4){height:11px} .ds-strokes span.is-done { background:#24e08a; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(22,184,119,0.5); }

narrative.overview: The student portal is the madrasah's e-glass teaching board turned into an interface. Learning is the practice of a script written in chalk: a student's progress renders as an Arabic letterform that glows in from a faint ghost to bright chalk as it is mastered, and the whole portal is the dark board that letterform is written on. Chalk-white text on a deep green-black ground, lit sheets, ruled hairlines, a tiny disciplined monospace hand. Hierarchy is scale contrast, never chrome. It refuses the LMS card-dashboard, the gold-on-green tile cliché, and the warm-cream-paper AI default; the board is the product's own teaching instrument and lets the brand green sit at home.
keyCharacteristics: Chalk-white text on a deep green-black board; the brand green is the one glowing accent.
A monumental Amiri Arabic glyph as the hero, written in glowing chalk to real progress.
Lit sheets with ruled hairline edges floating on the board — not rounded app cards.
Monospace specimen labels and readouts for measured values only.
Scale-contrast hierarchy; registration ticks and ruled sections instead of boxes.
Every text pair meets WCAG AA on the dark ground.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal (#24e08a) is the only saturated color and appears on a small fraction of any screen — the primary action, the active state, the mastered stroke. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Tinted-Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary and faint text is drawn from the board’s green hue (#b9c2c1 / #7e8a89), never a cool gray. No slate/gray values exist in this world.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for genuine measurement — IDs, counts, weeks, percentages. Never a costume for 'technical' prose.

rules.name: The Scale-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and weight steps, not added chrome, boxes, or color.

rules.name: The Paper-Not-Card Rule
rules.body: Containers are sheets of paper: warm raised surface, hairline ruled edge, ~4px corners, one soft paper shadow. No app-card chrome, gradients, or glass.

dos: Do keep ink-on-warm-paper: ground #000000, ink #f4f7f6, secondary from the paper hue.
Do use Brand Green (#24e08a) only for the primary action, active/live state, and mastery.
Do render containers as ruled paper sheets and separate groups with hairlines, not nested cards.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for measured values and specimen labels (UPPERCASE, 0.16em).
Do let the Arabic letterform carry hero scale; hierarchy is scale contrast.
Do give dense lists a mono section header and ruled entries so a long run has rhythm.
donts: Don't introduce slate/gray neutrals, pure white, or pure black.
Don't use a second saturated color, gradients, glass/blur-as-decoration, colored glows, or hard offset shadows.
Don't build same-size app cards (or nested cards) as the page structure.
Don't use monospace as a costume for prose, or set status colors as filled pill backgrounds.
Don't alter Qurʾānic/lesson content or its Amiri Quran rendering — this system governs the portal shell only.
Don't reintroduce a light/dark theme toggle here; the world is committed to one paper treatment.
